title: No customer support at all - app not working properly
body:
I have premium. This would be a great app if it worked properly or if anyone would ever respond to any communication. It’s a disgustingly poor level of customer service in that it’s zero, it’s non-existent. 

The apple health steps integration doesn’t work, in that it’s widely inaccurate.

I used to be able to track habits monthly, now that’s from the app. 

Such a shame that they think they just ignore customers like this.

author: Silvine67

title: Disappointed
body: I found out about this app through an insta ad. I thought it could help me keep track of things I needed to daily and to focus on getting rid of bad habits. I’m 14 years old and I was excited to use this basic app until I quickly found out you can only make 3 goals before it gives you a pop up ad to purchase premium. This disappointed me heavily as I think this had a lot more potential than to charge €60 a year for a basic app. It’s safe to say I won’t be using this app again (instant delete off my phone) and instead will journal what I need to do. This app could help so much more people if you didn’t charge that much for it.  Thank you for reading and take care of yourself 💖
author: TurtleQueeb

title: Lost Data
body:
For an app that demands a steep subscription and whose only job is to track information daily, I expect it to work without exception.

I recently lost years worth of data, the icloud backup doesn't work, and customer service is nowhere to be found. Even the LINK to contact customer service in the app was broken.
